title: Curriculum Overview
content:
Minhaajulhudaa Islamic & Arabic School offers a purely Islamic and Arabic studies curriculum, covering from Tamheedy (Preparatory) to Thanawiyyah (Secondary) level. Our curriculum includes:

## Qur'an Studies
- Reading with Tajweed
- Memorization (Hifz)
- Tafsir (Exegesis)

## Arabic Language
- Nahwu (Grammar)
- Sarf (Morphology)
- Balaghah (Rhetoric)
- Literature

## Islamic Sciences
- Fiqh (Jurisprudence)
- Aqeedah (Creed)
- Hadith Studies
- Seerah (Prophetic Biography)
- Usul al-Fiqh

## Levels
1. Tamheedy (Preparatory)
2. Ibtidaiyah 1-3 (Elementary)
3. Idadiyah 1-3 (Intermediate)
4. Thanawiyyah 1-3 (Secondary)
excerpt: Overview of our Islamic and Arabic studies curriculum from Tamheedy to Thanawiyyah.

title: Admission Process Guide
content:
## Admission Process

1. **Application**: Complete the admission form online or at the school office.
2. **Assessment**: Prospective students undergo an age-appropriate assessment.
3. **Interview**: Parents and students meet with the admission committee.
4. **Decision**: Admission decisions are communicated within 2 weeks.
5. **Registration**: Complete registration and fee payment.

## Required Documents
- Birth certificate
- Previous school records (if applicable)
- Passport photographs
- Medical information

## Age Requirements
- Tamheedy: 5-6 years
- Ibtidaiyah 1: 6-7 years
- Transfer students: Assessment-based placement
excerpt: Step-by-step guide to the admission process at Minhaajulhudaa School.

title: Fee Structure Explained
content:
## Fee Structure (1447 AH / 2026 CE)

### Tuition Fees (Per Term)
- Tamheedy: 25,000 NGN
- Ibtidaiyah: 30,000 NGN
- Idadiyah: 35,000 NGN
- Thanawiyyah: 40,000 NGN

### Additional Fees
- Registration (one-time): 5,000 NGN
- Books and materials: 10,000-15,000 NGN
- Hifz program (optional): 15,000 NGN

### Payment Schedule
- Term 1: September
- Term 2: January
- Term 3: April

### Discounts
- Sibling discount: 10% for second child, 15% for third
- Hifz students: 20% discount on regular tuition
